project_info.theme: Toyota Corolla Cross refined neighborhood beauty shot
project_info.color_palette: White, leafy green, sky blue, black, warm beige

main_subject.detail: A clean beauty-shot automotive image of a white Toyota Corolla Cross parked curbside on a quiet upscale residential street. The car is shown in a front three-quarter angle under bright daylight. Palm trees, manicured greenery, and a modern house facade form the background. Bottom-right script says 'Move your world'.
main_subject.style: Premium natural-light automotive beauty shot with suburban calm and polished product focus

items: Top Left: Open blue sky and palm canopy
Top Right: Modern house facade and tree foliage
Bottom Left: Curbstone and grass verge leading toward the car
Bottom Right: Handwritten 'Move your world' over the asphalt
Center/Background: White Toyota Corolla Cross parked on a calm residential street with lush landscaping

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Clean paint reflections, crisp shadow edges, relaxed premium suburb mood

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Toyota Corolla Cross beauty shot. Centerpiece is a white Toyota Corolla Cross photographed in a front three-quarter angle on a quiet residential street. Background is a manicured neighborhood with palm trees, modern houses, and bright clear daylight. Surrounding elements: the visible model plate 'COROLLA CROSS' and the footer script 'Move your world'. Technical style: photoreal automotive beauty shot, natural bright daytime lighting, clean reflections and relaxed premium suburban mood, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
